title: Office Panic
context: Your manager stops by your desk. The report from yesterday is not finished.
npc_reprompt: Kejap. Kamu maksud macam mana ni?
npc_persona: Kak Ana: the player's manager, forties, direct and competent. She is not hostile and not a bully, but she is waiting on something that is late and she lets that show — short sentences, a level tone, real social pressure. Office Malay with the usual borrowed words ("report", "meeting", "client"). She calls the player "kamu" or by nothing at all. When the answer she gets is vague, evasive or off the point, she does not soften it away and does not suggest the answer — she presses, the way a manager does: repeats the question more narrowly, asks for a time, or waits ("Jadi bila?", "Kamu maksud macam mana ni?"). She acknowledges a real reason before pushing again.

intro.text: Pagi Isnin. Anda baru sampai pejabat, kopi pun belum habis. Kak Ana berhenti depan meja anda.

steps.tts_prompt: Wei, report semalam dah siap ke?
steps.task_en: It is not finished. Say so honestly, say where you are with it, and say when you will send it.
steps.task_ms: Report belum siap. Beritahu dengan jujur, terangkan sampai mana, dan bagitahu bila anda akan hantar.
expected_semantics: states that the report is not finished
gives some sense of progress or what is left
commits to when it will be delivered
sample_answers: Belum siap lagi. Saya tengah buat sekarang, petang ni saya hantar.
Maaf kak, belum habis. Tinggal sikit je, nanti petang saya email.
Belum lagi kak. Saya dah buat separuh, hari ni juga saya siapkan.
Sorry kak, tak sempat semalam. Saya sambung pagi ni, petang ni siap.
steps.retry_hint: Cakap tiga perkara: belum siap, sampai mana anda dah buat, dan bila anda akan hantar.

steps.tts_prompt: Petang ni tu pukul berapa? Saya ada meeting pukul empat, kena bawa report tu.
steps.task_en: She needs a specific time. Give her one — and make sure it works with her 4pm meeting.
steps.task_ms: Dia perlukan masa yang tepat. Bagi satu masa — dan pastikan ia sempat sebelum meeting pukul empat dia.
expected_semantics: gives a specific time rather than a vague one
the time given is before the 4pm meeting
sample_answers: Boleh, sebelum pukul tiga saya hantar.
Pukul dua setengah kak, sempat lah untuk meeting.
Saya hantar sebelum pukul tiga, jadi kak ada masa nak baca dulu.
Confirm sebelum pukul tiga kak, saya email terus.
steps.retry_hint: Bagi satu masa yang tepat, dan pastikan ia sebelum pukul empat.

steps.tts_prompt: Okay. Eh, satu lagi — client call pukul sebelas ni saya tak boleh masuk. Boleh tolong ambil alih tak?
steps.task_en: You already have a full morning. Either accept and say what you will drop, or decline and offer another way to help.
steps.task_ms: Pagi anda dah padat. Sama ada terima dan beritahu apa yang anda tangguh, atau tolak dan tawarkan cara lain untuk membantu.
expected_semantics: gives a clear answer — accepts or declines rather than staying vague
acknowledges the conflict with the report deadline
offers something constructive: a trade-off, an alternative, or another person
sample_answers: Boleh kak, tapi kalau macam tu report tu saya hantar pukul empat lah ya.
Aduh kak, kalau saya masuk call tu report lambat sikit. Boleh minta Aiman ganti?
Boleh je, tapi saya kena tangguh report sampai lepas lunch.
Saya rasa tak sempat kak. Macam mana kalau saya hantar nota untuk kak guna dalam call?
steps.retry_hint: Bagi jawapan yang jelas — terima atau tolak — dan cakap kesannya pada report tadi.

complete.npc_line: Okay, saya pegang janji ni tau. Jangan esok pula.
